R1 cross-family: HSV sev2 best (21.12dB) but far from 40dB. YCrCb saturation (Cr/Cb *2) is the other x_distortion saturation family; chroma_ratio 2.56 in pair0 could match the 2x scale.

R2 blur on top: HSV:2 sim has higher block_boundary (+99%) and overshoot (+156%) than target -> target smoother, blur likely. Physical order blur(priority1) before global(priority2). Gaussian sev2 (sigma=2) safe default; pair4 ss_ratio=1.205 suggests sev>=2.
R3 severity scan (mandatory): gaussian:2 (+HSV:2) gave 23.43dB/CI8. Scan sev+1 (sigma=3) before switching blur subtype.

R2 blur subtype switch: glass_score=0.80/1.07 in pairs 1/4 (Laplacian/gradient ratio, pixel-shuffle high-freq residue). Glass shuffle could explain target's higher zero_crossing_density (24%) and colorful mottling in flat sky after saturation. glass sev2=(sigma0.9,shift2,iter1).
R3 severity scan (3rd severity candidate): target gradient ratio 0.334 vs g2-sim 0.217, glass2-sim 0.263 -> target SHARPER than tested blurs; scan gaussian sev1 (sigma=1).

R2 order test: diff map shows thin edge-outline residual; if saturation clipping happens BEFORE blur, clipped edges are softened in target while our blur->sat sim keeps them crisp. Testing sat->blur order (violates default priority but generator may differ).

R2 blur subtype: SKILL says gaussian<->lens MTF-indistinguishable, lens=alternative. Disk radius 3 (sev2) has sharper cutoff than gaussian sigma2; target gradient ratio 0.334 is between sims -> test lens family.

R3 noise: sky-region residual vs sim is independent white noise (corr with clean ~0.01, spatial corr 0.17, sigma~2.4 R/G, 1.3 B); target ZC consistently +0.11..0.14 above all sims, overshoot lower -> additive pre-blur noise. RGB sev1 (sigma=12.75) attenuated by gaussian sigma=2 -> ~1.8.

R3 blur severity with noise: noise+blur:2+HSV:2 gave CI 9/10 (ZC, hf_lf, unique colors all match). Its sky noise R/G slightly high (2.7 vs 2.4). Blur sev3 attenuates noise more (12.75->1.2); check CI and sky sigma.
R3 noise subtype: target sky per-channel hf R/G/B=2.42/2.41/1.24; RGB-noise sims give too little B (0.25-0.54). YCrCb noise adds Cr/Cb (B via 1.772*Cb) -> test YCrCb sev1 + g3 + HSV2.

R4 pair2 noise-type comparison: same deterministic core, YCrCb noise instead of RGB. Decide noise subtype by same-pair CI/PSNR comparison in paired-support set.
R4 pair3 cross-validation (RGB noise): test paired-support consistency on third image.
R4 pair4 cross-validation (RGB noise): pair4 showed the strongest blur evidence (ss_ratio 1.205, glass_score 1.07); check whether gaussian:3 still fits on this content.

R3 global family confirm: sky residual shows systematic B offset -8.8 (target bluer than HSV:2 sim). YCrCb saturation scales Cb/Cr keeping Y -> different blue handling. YCrCb sev2 (x3.0) untested; YCrCb sev1 under-clipped.

R1 baseline re-validation [signal_reanalysis]: R0 pipeline re-simulated under signal mode (noise present -> PSNR seed-limited). Re-checks blur spectral_slope/Wiener, noise sigma/§B residual structure, global mean_shift/variance_ratio.

compression.diagnosis: NO JPEG in all 5 pairs (0%-FP signal); dct_zero_ratio < 0.50 threshold.

blur.diagnosis: Isotropic (ratio_x≈ratio_y) -> not motion. Blur presence established by adding blur candidates: PSNR 21.12 (HSV2 only) -> 23.43 (g2) -> 23.78 (g3); zero-clip match only in blur->sat order. Estimated severity 2-3; gaussian:3 chosen (severity scan 1/2/3), lens:2 and glass:2 kept as family alternatives.

global.diagnosis: Single global step = saturate_strengthen_HSV:2 (S*6). It alone reproduces the -29.8 mean shift via min-channel lowering, 23.5% clipping, chroma_ratio 2.48 vs 2.56. Separate brightness step excluded: categories are unique in blind_challenge generator and the detected 'brightness' was fully explained by saturation.

paired_validation_final_pipeline.note: PSNR capped by random noise seed amplified 6x by the saturation step (noise seed unknowable) - CI metrics are the discriminative evidence.

coupling_analysis.noise_blur_coupling: Noise precedes blur (noise priority0 < blur priority1). Gaussian sigma=3 attenuates sev1 sigma=12.75 by ~0.094 -> residual noise ~1.2-1.8, explaining why wavelet noise_prior reported only 0.49-1.98 and why 'NO_NOISE' was initially plausible. Per SKILL, §B noise type DT is unreliable (54.7%≈random) in noise->blur order -> noise type stays UNCERTAIN.
coupling_analysis.saturation_clipping_false_positives: Heavy saturation clipping (17-31% pixels at 0/255) destroys gradient-based signals: gm_ratio 0.32-1.07 with ss_ratio ~1.0 (BLUR_UNLIKELY false negative in pairs 0/2/3) and produces high glass_score (0.80/1.07 FP in pairs 1/4). It also inflates residual_intensity_corr (0.51-0.93) and cross_channel_corr (0.26-0.39), which caused the initial GAUSSIAN_YCrCb (low confidence) and gamma-suspect flags.
coupling_analysis.order_evidence: saturate->blur order rejected: 23.38 dB but CI 4/10 with 5.6pp under-clipping (blur after clipping erases exact 0 pixels). blur->saturate matches zero-clip to 0.4pp.
coupling_analysis.jpeg_masking: No JPEG needed to explain any signal; block_boundary remains ~1.0 in all pairs even after 24-31% clipping, so a hidden JPEG before saturation is unlikely (would still leave residual block structure in unclipped regions).

pipeline.evidence: Flat-region sky noise sigma R/G/B 2.42/2.41/1.24 reproduced by sev1 after blur attenuation; type ambiguous vs YCrCb (YCrCb variant also CI 9/10, 23.12/23.21 dB); noise->blur order makes type DT unreliable per SKILL. Never LIKELY.

Blur confirmed by PSNR/CI improvements over saturation-only (21.12->23.43->23.78) and by zero-clip matching only in blur-first order; isotropic gradients exclude motion; gaussian:3 best of sev 1/2/3 scan; lens:2 (23.10) and glass:2 (22.75) are close family alternatives (MTF-indistinguishable). PSNR<30 due to noise seed -> UNCERTAIN.

Strongest signal: chroma_ratio 2.0-3.3 replicated (sim 2.48 vs target 2.56), clipping 23.4% vs 23.7%, mean shift -29.4 vs -29.8; HSV family decisively beats YCrCb (14.7-14.8 dB) and sev1/sev3 (18.9/18.5). PSNR<30 due to noise seed -> per verdict rule stays UNCERTAIN (not LIKELY).

final_decision.rationale: 3-step pipeline with random noise (Tier 3): noise->blur(order-mandated)->saturation. Deterministic core (blur gaussian:3 + saturate HSV:2) matches all content-independent statistics and CI metrics 9-10/10 on all 5 paired supports; residual PSNR (21.7-26.3 dB) is capped by unknowable noise seed amplified 6x by saturation, so LIKELY is unattainable.

alternatives.evidence: same CI 9/10 on pairs 0 and 2; PSNR 23.12 (pair0) / 23.21 (pair2); slightly better B-channel noise match
blur family alternative: 23.10 dB CI 8/10 (pair0, no noise step); gaussian<->lens MTF indistinguishable
blur severity alternative: 22.86 dB CI 9/10 (pair0); sky noise slightly high (2.7 vs 2.4)

noise_6step_check.note: Values measured by peeled_noise_check.py on residual after stripping the full candidate pipeline (blur_gaussian:3,saturate_strengthen_HSV:2; also re-run with noise step). residual std ~16.5-17.1 dominated by deterministic mismatch + random noise seed, so §B verdicts below are structural-residual artifacts, NOT usable (per SKILL reflection trigger: extreme_pct>50% AND noise_prior sigma<5 -> ignore §B IMPULSE).
noise_6step_check.diagnosis: §B unreliable (structured residual). Noise presence/level instead established by flat-region high-frequency analysis: target sky hf (median-filter residual) per-channel R/G/B = 2.42/2.41/1.24 vs clean 2.07/1.99/2.01 and noise-free sim 1.35/1.47/0.26; simulated noise_gaussian_RGB:1 -> gaussian:3 reproduces [2.06,2.14,0.25] and YCrCb:1 variant [2.25,2.25,0.45]. Noise is brightness-independent (flat-region sigma roughly constant across luminance bins 40-256) -> Gaussian family, NOT poisson/speckle. blur attenuates noise by ~1/(2*sqrt(pi)*3)=0.094, so sev1 sigma=12.75 -> ~1.2-1.8 post-blur, consistent with observed.

r1_summary.protocol: Re-ran run_full_analysis.py on all 5 support pairs; 5 signal-mode candidates via test_candidate.py (noise present -> PSNR not a criterion); peeled_noise_check.py on the best deterministic core; run_full_analysis.py on simulations as a second-order-statistics control. No GT and no test data used; forbidden paths (.ground_truth/, degradation_gt/, .gt_mappings/, E6_A, test_metrics, other challenge dirs) not accessed.
r1_summary.reanalysis_consistency: 5-pair signals reproduced R0 values exactly: block_boundary 0.9983-1.0103, unique_G 197-245, dct_zero 0.3387-0.449, sigma 0.49-1.98, chroma_ratio 1.999-3.333, clipped 0.177-0.306, variance_ratio 0.842-1.251, glass_score 0.8035/1.0691 (pairs 1/4), anisotropy 1.28-1.38 (<1.7).
key_findings: [statistical_check] Compression ruled out harder: the R0-pipeline simulation itself yields unique_G 236 (target 237, pair0) and 190 (target 197, pair4), and triggers the analyzer's MILD_COMPRESSION_POSSIBLE (dct_zero 0.525/0.502 vs target 0.449/0.434) while block_boundary stays ~1.0. The unique_G<200 boundary signal is a saturation-clipping artifact, not JPEG.

[signal_reanalysis] glass_score FP confirmed: the gaussian:3 simulation itself reproduces GLASS_BLUR verdicts (glass_score 0.90 pair0, 1.11 pair4; target 0.80/1.07 on pairs 1/4). Blur subtype evidence is unusable in the 18-31% clipped regime; gaussian stays the default (Wiener kernel self-consistency 0.999).

[signal_reanalysis] gamma_suspect_from_noise (ric 0.51-0.93) is a structural-residual artifact of saturation clipping: gamma (HSV/RGB) is a V-only scaling that lowers chroma and cannot reproduce chroma_ratio 2.0-3.3; HSV:2 saturation reproduces chroma/mean-shift/clipping nearly exactly.

[signal_reanalysis] Blur severity 3 vs 2 is content-conflicted: pair0 favors g2 (spectral_slope diff 0.065 vs 0.153; sigma proxy exact vs 50% low), pair4 favors g3 (slope 0.048 vs 0.096; Wiener 0.999 vs 0.943; variance_ratio 5.2% vs 24.7%). Aggregate check counts tie (7/5 both), g3 wins content-independent signals on both pairs -> keep g3. g1 rejected (Wiener 0.730, sigma proxy 200% off).

[statistical_check] Noise severity 1 confirmed by the wavelet-sigma proxy (pair4 0.1=0.1; pair0 sim control 1.36 vs target 1.73 = 22% low; sev2 would roughly double). Noise subtype not arbitrable: peeled residual structured (extreme_pct 69.5%, spatial_corr 0.96, FWHM 6-8px, residual std 12.0) -> SKILL documented FP regime; noise->blur order DT 54.7%~random; rgb_ratio 1.53-1.81 derives from the structured residual. Keep RGB, YCrCb alternative retained.

[alternatives] Saturation HSV:2 unchanged: simulation reproduces chroma 2.43 vs 2.56 (pair0) and 2.003 vs 1.999 (pair4), mean_shift -29.9 vs -29.8 / -38.9 vs -39.1, clipping 23.6% vs 23.5% / 31.1% vs 30.6%.
[signal_reanalysis] Order noise->blur->saturate unchanged (physical priorities; simulation reproduces the target's analyzer verdicts incl. brightness_darken and saturation_strengthen).
r1_summary.decision_basis: No signal-supported correction beyond R0 within the 5-candidate budget. Per REFLECTION_MECHANISM: no improvement -> BEYOND_CAPABILITY, keep R0 pipeline. Blur severity shows a per-pair signal conflict with g3 winning the content-independent checks; noise subtype is not arbitrable; saturation/compression/order are confirmed. Changing the pipeline on conflicting evidence would be a forced change.
r1_summary.training: No R1 training proposed: predicted pipeline unchanged, R0 training strategy (Direct + Swin + SimpleGate, EPOCH=2, LR=5e-4, batch=16) remains applicable. training_strategy_R1.json intentionally not emitted (decision=NO_CHANGE).

evidence_sources: skill tools: run_full_analysis.py, test_candidate.py (signal mode), verify_signals.py, peeled_noise_check.py

signal_reinterpretation.compression_boundary_unique_G_197: Signal: pair4 unique_G_target=197 (<200, SKILL 0%-FP rule for comp/quant) and unique_G_ratio 0.782; dct_zero 0.434. Reinterpretation [statistical_check]: the gaussian:3+HSV:2+RGBT noise simulation of pair4 yields unique_G=190 and dct_zero=0.502 (pair0 sim: 236 vs target 237, dct 0.525 vs 0.449) and is itself flagged MILD_COMPRESSION_POSSIBLE. Saturation clipping (30.6% clipped pixels at 0/254-255) collapses the color histogram and inflates DCT zeros; block_boundary stays 0.998-1.010 in both target and simulation. Conclusion: NO_COMPRESSION stands.
signal_reinterpretation.glass_score_fp: Signal: glass_score 0.8035 (pair1) / 1.0691 (pair4) -> analyzer GLASS_BLUR. Reinterpretation [signal_reanalysis]: pure-gaussian simulation reproduces glass_score 0.9011 (pair0) / 1.1096 (pair4) and the GLASS_BLUR verdict, with no glass step. Clipping-induced gradient mottling creates the FP. Blur subtype stays gaussian (lens MTF-indistinguishable -> alternative).
signal_reinterpretation.gamma_suspect_ric: Signal: residual_intensity_corr 0.51-0.93, gamma_suspect_from_noise=True in all pairs; analyzer suggests gamma alternative. Reinterpretation [signal_reanalysis]: the residual is dominated by the nonlinear clipping boundary (spatial_corr 0.89-0.97), so intensity correlation is induced. Functionally, brightness_darken_gamma_HSV/RGB scale only V and would reduce chroma std, whereas the target chroma_ratio is 2.0-3.3x clean; only saturation strengthen can produce this. Gamma cannot replace the global step within 3 steps.
signal_reinterpretation.blur_presence_and_severity: Presence: Wiener kernel corr 0.943-0.999 (threshold 0.85) across all blur candidates -> target is blurred. Severity scan (signal mode): pair0 g3 WEAK(2/4, slope diff 0.153) -> g2 PARTIAL(4/2, diff 0.065, sigma exact) -> g1 WEAK(2/4, Wiener 0.730, sigma 200%); pair4 g2 WEAK(3/3, slope diff 0.096, var_ratio 24.7%) -> g3 PARTIAL(5/1, slope diff 0.048, Wiener 0.999, var_ratio 5.2%). The spectral-slope direction flips with content (pair0 target ~clean; pair4 target steeper than clean), so it is not a reliable severity discriminator here; Wiener kernel and variance_ratio favor g3 on both pairs. Keep gaussian:3 (also R0 PSNR scan 21.12->23.43->23.78).
signal_reinterpretation.noise_subtype_and_severity: Severity: wavelet-sigma proxy target vs sim: pair4 0.1 vs 0.1, pair0 1.73 vs 1.36 on the noise-free deterministic control (22% low), and 0.2 vs 0.1 in the R0 baseline test (g3 over-smoothing) -> sev1 consistent, sev2 would ~double. Subtype [signal_reanalysis]: peeled §B on pair4 (blur_gaussian:3,saturate_strengthen_HSV:2 stripped): extreme_pct 69.53%, vm_slope 3.07, var_slope 2.26, spatial_corr 0.9602, rgb_ratio 1.6685 (R/G/B std 10.6/15.3/9.2), cross_ch 0.1399, residual std 12.0, noise_prior sigma 1.98 (blur warning). Auto IMPULSE verdict is the documented §B FP (extreme_pct>50% AND sigma<5) -> discard. spatial_corr 0.96 shows the residual is structural; per SKILL the noise-type DT in noise->blur order is 54.7% ~ random and must stay UNCERTAIN. rgb_ratio>1.4 is not admissible on a structured residual. Keep noise_gaussian_RGB:1, YCrCb alternative.
signal_reinterpretation.saturation: Unchanged: HSV:2 (S*6) reproduces chroma_ratio, mean shift and clipping nearly exactly on both tested pairs; YCrCb family 6+ dB worse in R0; sev1/3 worse. Deterministic evidence content-independent.
signal_reinterpretation.order: Unchanged: noise->blur->saturate, consistent with physical priorities and the zero-clip evidence; the simulation reproduces the target's analyzer verdicts.

second_order_controls.method: run_full_analysis.py applied to the R0-pipeline simulations (g3) vs the target, same clean reference
second_order_controls.interpretation: Global/blur/noise second-order statistics reproduce target values closely; the analyzer's compression and glass heuristics are reproduced (or exceeded) by the simulation itself, proving they are pipeline artifacts rather than evidence of JPEG/glass.

noise_6step_check_r1.diagnosis: Structured residual (spatial_corr 0.96, residual std 12.0 dominant over sigma ~2) from saturation-clipping mismatch. Per SKILL: extreme_pct>50% AND sigma<5 -> ignore §B impulse; noise->blur order makes §B type DT 54.7%~random. Subtype remains UNCERTAIN; keep gaussian_RGB:1 with YCrCb alternative.

final_decision.rationale: Signal re-analysis and cross-pair validation support the R0 pipeline. The only candidate with a signal-level improvement (blur sev2) is content-conflicted and loses the content-independent checks on pair4; noise subtype is not arbitrable and stays UNCERTAIN; saturation, ordering and the absence of compression are confirmed by near-exact second-order reproduction. Per REFLECTION_MECHANISM no improvement -> BEYOND_CAPABILITY; do not force a change or training.
